name: Parking and Traffic Commission Meeting (Postponed)
agenda_text:
Notice of Meeting
  Postponement

  CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  PARKING AND TRAFFIC
  COMMISSION

Notice is hereby given that the Parking &
 Traffic Commission Meeting scheduled
  for Wednesday, March 22, 2023 has
  been postponed.

The next scheduled meeting date will be
  April 26, 2023
